brief:
Israeli forces released Palestinian journalist Abed Abou Shhadeh after a period of detention, Al Jazeera English reported. Shhadeh characterized his arrest as part of what he described as political measures aimed at intimidating Arab society broadly.

The journalist's release comes amid ongoing tensions between Israeli authorities and Palestinian media figures. Shhadeh's account adds to documented cases of Palestinian journalists detained by Israeli forces.
dek: Abed Abou Shhadeh says his detention was part of Israel's political measures 'to intimidate Arab society as a whole'.
title: Israeli forces release Palestinian journalist Abou Shhadeh
